Subject: Kickoff: Evaluation plan & MAP for Brightlane pilot

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The execs liked the latency/cost modeling but would like a clear evaluation runway and a mutual action plan that ties technical milestones to procurement and legal gates. Can you share a MAP template and an initial draft we can co-edit?

Two asks from our side to help us align quickly:
- a 30–60 day evaluation timeline with tech acceptance gates and an obvious POC pass/fail criteria
- a stubbed stakeholder RACI (we'll add our names) and a procurement checklist for cloud onboarding and KMS integration

If you can drop a Google Doc we can co-edit today that would be ideal — procurement will want to see the timeline when we circulate to finance.

Best,

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Elena Park <elena.park@brightlane.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Apr 2028 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Evaluation plan & MAP for Brightlane pilot

Elena — great to hear the execs liked the demo. I dropped a seeded MAP doc and a quick 2-slide week0/week1 play in the folder (links + PDF attached below). I sketched a practical 30-day POC that ties three tech milestones to procurement and legal checkpoints so your finance/KMS folks can review.

High-level 30-day proposal (seeded in the doc):
- Week 0 (0–3 days): access + sandbox provisioning. Deliverables: API keys, sample data ingest, security questionnaire answers.
- Week 1 (4–10 days): integration + smoke tests. Deliverables: sample inference runs, latency baseline, KV-prefix caching validation.
- Week 2 (11–18 days): workload validation. Deliverables: edge-case throughput, token-cost estimate, acceptance test results.
- Week 3–4 (19–30 days): acceptance & handoff. Deliverables: acceptance sign-off doc, cost/perf summary, rollout plan.

Acceptance criteria (short list in the doc):
- median latency < 120ms for 512 tokens in your sandbox workload
- accuracy/regression tolerance within agreed thresholds on the provided eval set
- deployment recipe for Dedicated or Private (as required) including KMS okays

Stakeholder RACI: I added placeholders for engineering leads, procurement, and security. Can Jordan (cc'd) add the tech contact section and Marissa can add CSM/renewal owners.

Links & attachments:
- Brightlane_MAP_template.gdoc — coauthor link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/BRIGHTLANE-MAP-SEED (co-edit enabled)
- MAP-starter-slides-v1.pdf — attached (2 slides: timeline + decision gates)

Next steps:
1) Elena — add your procurement/security names into the RACI and flag any missing legal gates.
2) Jordan — can you add a short tech checklist (network egress, KMS, VPC peering notes)?
3) Marissa — I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Tuesday to walk through the seeded MAP and confirm the demo acceptance tests.

Thanks — happy to co-edit live.

Best,
Ben Carter
